newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index falls 8.26pts on Slovnaft losses.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index falls 8.26pts on Slovnaft losses.

text.p: Leading Slovak shares closed mostly down in flat trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday, with losses to Slovnaft pulling the index 8.26 points lower to 190.32.
Brokers said the fall in the index had been predicted as flat trading had already been seen on the bourse, mostly on very small volumes, for a relatively long period of time.
"The index fell as it had deserved to due to such weak trading," said Radovan Dzuga of Creditanstalt.
Oil refinery Slovnaft closed down 90 crowns at 810, on volume of 12 shares.
"However, I think the price at 810 crowns in Slovnaft was a bit extreme, as I see its realistic level at about 850," Dzuga said.
Oil and gas storage company Nafta fell 48 crowns to 1,852, with only nine shares traded. Steel maker VSZ traded 1,002 shares, unchanged at 605 crowns.
Overall, volume rose to 544,070 shares from 394,252 on Wednesday, while turnover increased to 358.87 million crowns from 280.78 million.
